title: 한국샤드 SE지역 집짓기 일정.
bodyHtml:
Posted to the FYI:
Due to an unforseen issue, UO:SE house placement for the Arirang and Balhae shards has been delayed until the morning of Tuesday, Novemeber 23rd local time in Seoul, Korea.


11월 23일 화요일 확정.
